newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Off 0.100 to 0.150 cent. Carryover of showlists and packers have contract cattle available.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Corn futures seen higher and index only up slightly.
LEAN HOGS - Off 0.200 to up 0.100 cent. Steady to lower cash hog calls and easier pork product but looking ahead to tighter hog supplies.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Steady to lower cash product but continued tight storage supplies.
